name: How long does it take to see results from schema markup implementation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from schema markup implementation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time to see results from schema markup can vary. Search engines need to re-crawl and re-index your pages after implementation, which can take days to several weeks. Once indexed, the impact on rich results and AI visibility is often gradual. While some rich snippets may appear relatively quickly, significant improvements in search engine understanding and AEO performance may take a few weeks to several months as AI systems learn and adapt to the new structured data. Consistency and validity are key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results from schema markup implementation typically appear gradually, taking from a few days for indexing to several weeks or months for noticeable improvements in AEO performance.
